text:
sam (marketing): Team — planning a small launch for QuickForge Snack (OSS refapp + 15m walkthrough). Channels: short blog, gated demo, 90s social clip. Need benchmark framing, RSVP routing, and two quick A/B ideas for messaging. Launch in 10 days.

anya (devrel): For the benchmark story: pick a single user journey (email summarizer, 3-turn convo) and show p50/p95 + cost/1k tokens. Emphasize reproducibility and include the exact command to run.

jax (growth): RSVP form: one MCQ "Your focus" -> (prototype / product / infra). Route to three nurture tracks and tag `quickforge_rsvp`. We'll add utm_source per channel.

priya (engineer): Repo ready: https://github.com/redwood-inference/quickforge-snack. Bench script: `./bench/run.sh --concurrency 8 --seq 128 --save report.json`. It outputs JSON. We'll upload to S3 during demo.

ola (events): Webinar plan: 25m total (10 demo, 10 bench walkthrough, 5 Q&A). Recommended slot Wed 10am PT. We'll record a 90s teaser clip at rehearsal.

ci-bot: Preview deployed: https://quickforge-preview.redwood.ai — pipeline #129 passed :white_check_mark:

anya (devrel): Draft microcopy: Blog: "QuickForge Snack: a tiny OSS refapp to get running quickly, run a reproducible benchmark, and tune for latency & cost." Social: "QuickForge Snack — 15m OSS walkthrough + reproducible benchmark. Demo Wed 10am PT. RSVP: https://redwood.ai/quickforge (utm=tw)"

sam (marketing): small edit: call out "includes Docker + k8s manifest" in the blog blurb. For social, keep it punchy.

jax (growth): For the post-webinar follow-up, let's A/B 2 subject lines: A) "Your QuickForge benchmark & repo" B) "See how we hit 40ms p50 — QuickForge results". I'll split 50/50.

priya (engineer): Note: numbers vary by instance type; we'll append a tiny table (dev: g5 vs prod: a100) and include the exact bench command in the report JSON. Sample: {"p50_ms":40,"p95_ms":95,"cost_per_1k":"$0.10"}.

ola (events): Ops checklist: landing page + RSVP form, slides + rehearsal, 90s teaser, UTMs, infra on-call. Who owns slides?

sam (marketing): I will own slides + blog. anya owns demo script + benchmark narrative. jax owns registration funnel + nurture tags. priya infra/report shape. ola events ops.

anya (devrel): I'll add 3 short prompts to the tutorial to surface caching/batching wins and will record a 90s clip during rehearsal.

jax (growth): I'll draft reminder + post-webinar emails; sharing copy by Fri EOD. Also will run the 50/50 subject test.

sam (marketing): Great — next check Mon 10am PT to finalize assets. Post PR links and landing page draft here when ready. :rocket:
